limitations: 80 valid per-case workloads, not 80 fresh browser sessions: one fresh session per backend, alternating count/outline cases within it.
Ten clones remain loaded for every case; only the requested prefix renders. CPU includes explicit pose plus scene.render, not endFrame/present or full game logic.
Observed wall cadence changes from about 8.1 to 6.2 ms during the GL series. No FPS gain or backend-ranking conclusion.
GL timer values are fresh asynchronous whole-frame observations, not isolated vertex or outline-pass timers; WebGPU timer samples are unavailable.
CPU ranges mostly overlap; GL GPU outline cost is strong at 2/5 actors, but 10-actor GPU ranges overlap and have large spread.
Pixel visibility is not the draw coverage gate: screenshots show partially overlapping distant actors. Near silhouette/occlusion/every-pose acceptance remains future work.
All measured shader compile counts are zero. No CPU sampler or trace wrappers; 250 ms polling and passive counters remain.
